usagePrompt: Install @tarnadas/near-intents-deposit to add NEAR Intents cross-chain deposits to the native Orderly deposit form. Setup: (1) `npm install @tarnadas/near-intents-deposit`; (2) import `registerNearIntentsDepositPlugin` from "@tarnadas/near-intents-deposit" and add `import "@tarnadas/near-intents-deposit/dist/styles.css"`; (3) register it on `OrderlyAppProvider` via `plugins={[registerNearIntentsDepositPlugin({ jwtToken: import.meta.env.VITE_1CLICK_JWT })]}`. Optional: set `VITE_1CLICK_JWT` (from https://partners.near-intents.org) to waive the 0.2% 1-Click platform fee. The plugin replaces the Deposit form's script layer: users' connected-chain tokens with an on-chain balance are merged into the source token list; picking a cross-chain token triggers an automated quote -> wallet transfer -> NEAR Intents solve -> USDC vault deposit flow with a progress modal. Ensure the host resolves `@orderly.network/*` packages to a single copy (dedupe) to avoid duplicate React contexts.
